items.title: Clarify upload validation messages
items.notes: Users need immediate and actionable guidance when uploads fail.

items.title: Add quick correction chips for common amount/date fields
items.notes: Repeated correction interactions are slower than expected.

items.title: Improve low-confidence reason visibility in review panel
items.notes: Users want to understand why a field was flagged.

items.title: Add retry hint on rate-limit and transient API failures
items.notes: Pilot users retried manually without clear guidance.

items.title: Expose document-level processing ETA in jobs view
items.notes: Status visibility is sufficient but ETA would reduce uncertainty.

items.title: Add keyboard navigation for inline review edits
items.notes: Power users requested a faster edit loop.

items.title: Show export history timestamps in local timezone
items.notes: UTC-only timestamps were confusing for some pilot users.
